events.title: Big Demo 2.0 Update!
events.summary: Thanks for all your feedback, it’s been incredibly helpful in improving the game. events.title: Patch 1.03 - Achievements!
events.summary: NEWAdded 20 achievements. Good luck unlocking them! Please note: Some achievements, such as opening chests or using potions, cannot be unlocked retroactively because these actions were not tracked previously. Sorry!Added a “Delete Save Data” button to the settings menu for players who want to start over.

events.title: The gameplay of Idle Pixel Battle
events.summary: In this devlog, I would like to give you a closer look at the gameplay loop of Idle Pixel Battle and introduce some of the systems I have implemented over the past few months.From the different heroes and their abilities to randomized items and permanent upgrades, there are many ways to improve your party and progress further and further.The HeroesAt the beginning of each run, you assemble your party from a selection of different heroes. events.title: Thank you for 1000 Wishlists!
events.summary: Hey everyone!I’m very happy to share that Idle Pixel Battle has reached 1,000 wishlists on Steam! Thank you so much to everyone who has already added the game to their wishlist. It really means a lot to me and helps the game a ton, especially at this early stage. Right now, I’m continuing to work on the game every day.
